metadata.description: Standardized evaluation dataset for measuring Precision@K, NDCG@K, eligibility invariant enforcement, target vs adjacent role separation, and baseline comparison against naive skill Jaccard.

label_scale.3: Excellent Match — Target role, high verified evidence overlap, optimal growth
label_scale.2: Good Match — Taxonomy-adjacent or target role with minor skill stretch / uncertain deadline
label_scale.1: Weak Match — High overstretch or current lateral role with limited career progression
label_scale.0: Ineligible / Irrelevant — Hard constraint violation or completely unrelated domain
